label: Create the v1_archive schema and bound the lock wait

execute.description: fail the deploy rather than wait behind a long lock
execute.sql: SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '5s'
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS v1_archive
COMMENT ON SCHEMA v1_archive IS 'v1 sessions, threads, events and sandboxes, frozen at retirement on 2026-11-25. No deployed code reads this schema; keep the rows for analytics.'

postcheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname = 'v1_archive') AS "result"

label: Move public."Session" to the v1_archive schema

precheck.sql: SELECT to_regclass('public."Session"') IS NOT NULL AS "result"

execute.description: move table "Session" into v1_archive when it is still in public
execute.sql:
DO $$
BEGIN
  IF to_regclass('public."Session"') IS NOT NULL THEN
    ALTER TABLE public."Session" SET SCHEMA v1_archive;
  END IF;
END
$$

postcheck.sql: SELECT to_regclass('v1_archive."Session"') IS NOT NULL AS "result"
